territorial_competence_reference.joins: Joins A12, common floor, local and territorial authority, representative fiscal capacity and funded service continuity.

durable_capacity_reference.selection: Select ordinary elected correction when persistent physical shortages exceed interim capacity, with an independent check of omitted need.
durable_capacity_reference.evidence: Observed scope and constructed resource comparisons establish no actual authority, receipt or causal effect.
durable_capacity_reference.joins: Joins first-hour powers, fiscal durability, independent evidence and a prospective material allocation.

public_measure_reversal_reference.selection: Select a funded and staffed exit before major reliance and separate elected and legal corrections.
public_measure_reversal_reference.evidence: Original inquiry and constructed receiving comparisons establish no actual adopting authority or receipt.
public_measure_reversal_reference.joins: Joins independent judicial orders, elected disposition, actual downstream execution and continuing public services.

work_and_material_independence_reference.selection: Select independently usable work and funded residual voting access without forced choices.
work_and_material_independence_reference.evidence: Official legal and research comparators and constructed cases establish no actual paid capacity or effect.
work_and_material_independence_reference.joins: Joins competition, material freedom, independently funded worker and voter access, and continuing rights.

long_horizon_public_choice_reference.selection: Select dated long-horizon rights, physical and financial protection with independent challenge and elected choice.
long_horizon_public_choice_reference.evidence: Appraisal and governance comparators and constructed cases establish no real asset, authority, receipt or outcome.
long_horizon_public_choice_reference.joins: Joins investment commitments, exposed ecological and service functions, budget succession and lawful remaining choices.

independent_public_judgment_reference.selection: Select independent evidence and challenge when cross-sector services can reinforce their shared inference.
independent_public_judgment_reference.evidence: Institutional risk analysis and constructed cases establish no national effect or authority.
independent_public_judgment_reference.joins: Joins public AI use, remaining demand, independent authored alternatives, service delivery and lawful sector budgets.

reciprocal_supply_reference.selection: Select open trade with independently qualified reciprocal and reserve coverage for essential supply.
reciprocal_supply_reference.evidence: Written and modelled comparator material and constructed stress cases establish no actual partner assent or delivery.
reciprocal_supply_reference.joins: Joins lawful external supply, donor and receiver duties, dated public costs and household services.

joint_country_feasibility_reference.selection: Select a whole-package elected motion with executable assignments and common early commitments before information arrives.
joint_country_feasibility_reference.evidence: Observed accounting and authored first-mandate conditions establish no actual national funding, capacity or welfare effect.
joint_country_feasibility_reference.joins: Joins first supply, independent early evidence, qualified service assignments and continuing rights.

comparative_country_validation_reference.selection: Select comparable disaggregated outcome evidence and a qualified local comparison across actual budget alternatives.
comparative_country_validation_reference.evidence: Two official survey years reproduce descriptive distributions without policy attribution; constructed options do not prove delivery.
comparative_country_validation_reference.joins: Joins observed access, separate denominators, constrained clinical receipt and choices among ordinary and structural alternatives.

clinical_pathway_bottlenecks_reference.selection: Select a scoped audit and funded receiving repair before general clinical capacity expansion.
clinical_pathway_bottlenecks_reference.evidence: National administrative tables and original indicator workbooks identify diagnostic leads with distinct scopes.
clinical_pathway_bottlenecks_reference.joins: Joins early access, a realistic referral, clinical authority, actual receiving and an exact budget motion.
